verdict.rationale: Khoj is itself an AI assistant, and its docs show users handing it tasks: chatting with it grounded in their files, creating agents with custom persona, knowledge and tools, having it generate and run Python for data analysis and reports, and scheduling automations that run queries and email the research back. Community comments discuss chat quality and model requirements but do not contradict that the assistant does this work. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated multi-step tasks, and documented depth beyond 'simple' code execution and research-style queries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You can chat with it about anything. It'll use files you shared with it to respond, when relevant. It can also access information from the public internet.
Create agents with custom knowledge, persona, chat model and tools to take on any role.
This is useful if you want to have Khoj do some data analysis, generate plots and reports.
Automations allow you run your query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency. Khoj will send its research to you as an email.
